title: Contracts
summary: A document sent for approval and signature, which can then become a job and an invoice.
html:
A contract works like a quote — it is sent to a customer or lead, they approve it, and the approved contract becomes a job or an invoice. The difference is emphasis: a quote is a price, a contract is terms.

Creating one

Contracts → Create Contract, pick the customer, and write the content. Contracts use templates, so standard terms are written once and reused rather than pasted each time. See Templates.

Sending and signing

Emailing the contract sends the customer a link. They read it and sign on screen; the drawn signature, the date and their IP address are recorded against the contract.

That is an ordinary electronic signature. Whether it satisfies a particular legal requirement depends on your jurisdiction and what you are signing — take advice rather than assuming.

Numbering

  • contract_name_incrementing switches automatic numbering on.
  • contract_name_incrementing_next is the next number.

After approval

An approved contract can be turned into a job to track the work, or straight into an invoice.
